name: A very long turn that finishes is worth a cheer
case: The agent works for twenty minutes and finishes well. That stands out: Boop celebrates the finish with a cheer, in an excited, proud or happy face, and its mood becomes excited (or proud).
why: PERSONALITY's Examples: a very long turn finishing done stands out, so it gets a cheer in an excited, proud or happy face; no rule cheers (BEHAVIORS.md §3.1). It's a reason to leave happy for excited (plan/steering/mood/happy.md)
